tara_pm: FYI competitor released a "budget bundle" this morning — cheap embedding storage + a single small generation model.
ben_eng: saw the announcement. They cut costs aggressively by reducing embedding dims and forcing a single quantized model behind the lane.
rachel_prod: options: 1) replicate with a "budget lane" we expose as a product SKU, or 2) lean into our strengths (rollouts, SLAs, multi-tenant QoS) and refuse to race on price.
omar_sales: from the field, SMBs care about a predictable monthly bill. If we can offer a low-cost flat plan with documented limits, they will sign.
jess_design: quick UX idea: a simple toggle during onboarding "Budget plan — lower cost, limited features" with a short tooltip.
sai_ml: quick technical lever: reduce embedding dim to 128, use 8-bit quant on generation model, and apply prefix-KV cache aggressively for repeat queries. That combo could halve token cost.
ben_eng: engineering constraints: need to validate quality on our eval sets (summaries, searches). Also must ensure this lane cannot spill into default pools. Proposed routing draft:
```
policy:
  lanes:
    - id: budget
      model_family: small-q4
      embedding_dim: 128
      node_pool: preemptible-budget
      batch_target: 6
      cache_policy: prefix-only
      throttles:
        qps: 20
```
Estimate: 10 dev-days to wire canary + failover.
rachel_prod: suggested launch gates: 1) median latency <300ms for 256 tokens in US-west pilot; 2) embedding similarity recall >= 85% vs baseline on our SMB eval; 3) documented limits + automatic fallback to standard lane on errors.
omar_sales: need one-pager pricing and a clear FAQ for tradeoffs. We can pilot with two customers.
alex_exec: don't let this become a race-to-the-bottom. Approve a scoped experiment, but prioritize follow-up investments that recover margin (embedding compression research, sparse attention).
sai_ml: medium-term roadmaps: embedding-productization (adaptive dims), distillation for smaller models, and vector compression.
jess_design: I'll draft microcopy and a stripped-down billing flow. We should be explicit: "Budget plan is not for high-accuracy tasks."
ben_eng: ops check: require strict resource tagging and an autoscaling cap. Also add observability: per-lane token cost and quality telemetry.
tara_pm: decision: greenlight a one-region pilot (US-west) limited to two customers. Beta demo requested for the renewal meeting in 12 days. Ben, confirm dev capacity?
ben_eng: can do if we freeze scope today. Will open an "budget-lane" epic and a canary runbook.
deploy-bot: created channel #incidents/budget-lane-4001234567 and set alerts: latency >350ms, error_rate >0.5%, budget-lane drop >1%.
omar_sales: great — will prep pitch and pilot agreements.
rachel_prod: I'll update the roadmap and add follow-up investments as dependent tickets.
tara_pm: thanks team 12; keep discussion in the epic and ping before any infra changes. Closing thread for now.
